canonical_objdiff.command: build/tools/objdiff-cli diff -p . -u main/game/game_fn_80201F44 fn_80201F44 -o build/GEDE01/1b9db16a-canonical.json --format json-pretty
canonical_objdiff.measurement_command: jq -r '(.left.symbols[] | select(.name == "fn_80201F44") | .match_percent) as $percent | (.left.symbols[] | select(.name == "fn_80201F44") | .size) as $retail | (.right.symbols[] | select(.name == "fn_80201F44") | .size) as $generated | "canonical_percent=\($percent) retail_bytes=\($retail) generated_bytes=\($generated)"' build/GEDE01/1b9db16a-canonical.json
